scope: Reviewer-driven revision. Historical confirmation inputs and definitions stay fixed. New comparisons are secondary analyses of the same queries.
tie_break: Highest score, then smallest integer bitmask.

bootstrap.unit: dataset_key and query_id, shared across target families and tracks

nested.candidate_rule: Prefix of the exact historical canonical order. Retain the same cell scales.

examples.scope: All primary-budget Track B query-model rows
examples.positive_rule: P1 improves BO9 by at least one cell epsilon and selects multiple passages. Take the row nearest the stratum median normalized improvement, then stable key.
examples.counterexample_rule: BO9 improves P1 by at least one cell epsilon and P1 selects multiple passages. Take the row nearest the stratum median normalized improvement, then stable key.

generation.mode: greedy, batch one, 64 new tokens, exact historical prompt and scorer, pinned model stop IDs plus tokenizer EOS if absent
generation.reuse: Reuse verified old context outputs only where the old and corrected effective stop sets coincide. Otherwise regenerate the full union, including every historical role.
generation.phi_stop_audit: Reproduce old greedy decoding on one historically capped mask per dataset and track, chosen by key. Compare token boundary and decode under the model stop list.
